# Chef Michel Karam

> Michel Karam is an executive chef and culinary consultant based in Lebanon, with over 25 years of professional experience in hospitality operations across the MENA region, Europe, and Asia. He works with restaurant and bar owners to build menus, kitchen systems, and operational standards that perform consistently in real service.

## Pages

- [Home](https://chefmichelkaram.com/): Overview of Michel Karam's culinary consulting practice, services, and professional profile
- [About](https://chefmichelkaram.com/about): Professional background, culinary philosophy, and 25-year career spanning Lebanon, Bahrain, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Malaysia, and beyond
- [Services](https://chefmichelkaram.com/services): Culinary consulting services including menu development, kitchen operations, brigade training, pre-opening support, and cost control
- [Portfolio](https://chefmichelkaram.com/portfolio): Visual portfolio of signature dishes, seafood, meat, starters, desserts, banquets, buffets, and live stations
- [Awards](https://chefmichelkaram.com/awards): Professional recognition including Gold Medal and Finest Chef Award at the Malaysia International Gastronomy Festival (2011), Shield of Honor from Chaîne des Rôtisseurs Bahrain, and Letter of Recommendation from the U.S. Embassy Beirut
- [Press](https://chefmichelkaram.com/press): Editorial features including Time Out Outstanding Chef of the Year, MIGF publications, and restaurant media coverage
- [Contact](https://chefmichelkaram.com/contact): Contact information for consulting inquiries — email, phone, and WhatsApp

## About Michel Karam

Michel Karam started his professional culinary career in 2000. He has led kitchens through pre-openings, restructured operations under pressure, built brigades from scratch, and developed menus across restaurants, resorts, diplomatic institutions, and multi-outlet operations. His consulting work focuses on standalone restaurants and bars in Lebanon, offering menu audits, kitchen workflow restructuring, team training, and one-visit operational diagnostics.

**Specialties:** Menu Development · Kitchen Systems & Workflow · Brigade Training · Concept Development · Pre-Opening Support · Cost Control

**Languages:** English, Arabic, French

**Location:** Lebanon (serves Lebanon and the MENA region)

**Contact:** chefmichel@me.com · +961 3 575 876
